name: @app-patterns/settings-electron
description: The Electron host for the shared Settings window: bridle-settings: IPC over the settings store, the single Settings window, the generated menu, export and import panels, key slots over safeStorage, and the preload bridge.

scripts.build:deps: bun run --cwd ../commands build && bun run --cwd ../settings build && bun run --cwd ../settings-react build
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/main.ts ./src/preload.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external --splitting
scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.check: bun run build:deps && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
